title: Review panel removed from the UAP Disclosure Act
summary: Ryan Graves tells of Review panel removed from the UAP Disclosure Act, about 2023-2024 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh, I think that was my biggest disappointment that that was removed from the first version of the UAP Disclosure Act

plain: Ryan Graves is a former US Navy fighter pilot who now speaks publicly about unidentified objects, which the government now calls UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena. He talks about the UAP Disclosure Act, a bill put before Congress in 2023 that would have forced the government to release its records on such objects, and says a review panel in the first version was removed, apparently an independent board that would have decided what got released. Graves calls that removal his biggest disappointment, since in his view the panel would have given the public a real route to the records.
